feat(collector): a watch and a period refresh a session's transcript lanes, and a request waits on its world state (candybar-skeleton-wj0c.zhh)

One keyed entry per followed session reads every transcript lane (session,
speed, context, metrics, activity, cache, auto-compact). A watch on the
transcript and on Claude Code's settings file reads them again after a write,
and a 10 s backstop period catches a dropped event. A request is no longer a
trigger: it waits only for its world state's first readings, so a warm
session draws at once.

- Each lane's owner records its refresh under the trigger that caused it
  (first, period, change), and every refresh writes its own line, so a lane
  that never lands is the one whose line is missing.
- `request` leaves the refresh triggers; the render event's `refreshed=` field,
  the adapter's refresh reach and RefreshTimes are gone.
- Speed takes a sample only when the transcript's stamp moved.
- `today` leaves the transcript lanes: its fault is the session lane's.

chore(release): set `package.json` to 1.221.0

## [1.221.0](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/compare/v1.220.0...v1.221.0) (2026-11-15)

### Bug Fixes

* **click:** the host opens every link's signature before a renderer sees it, and tells the app its verdict at once (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.35o) ([#759](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/759)) ([a7e8d92](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/a7e8d92192edfafdbf0875132bfa65803bef6458)), closes [#fragment](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/fragment)
